वैराज

VAIRĀJA One of the Sapta pitṛs (Seven Manes). The Sapta pitṛs are, vairāja, agniṣvātta, somapā; Gārhapatya, ekaśṛṅga, caturveda and kala. (M.B. Sabhā Parva, Chapter 11, Stanza 46).

वैरामस्

VAIRĀMAS . A caste of people in Ancient india. The people of this caste gave dharmaputra, various kinds of jewels and other costly things as presents and then attended the rājasūya of the pāṇḍavas. (M.B. Sabhā Parva, Chapter 51, Verse 12).

वैराट

VAIRĀṬA . One of the hundred sons of dhṛtarāṣṭra. It is mentioned in mahābhārata, bhīṣma parva, Chapter 96, Verse 26, that this vairāṭa was killed in the battle of bhārata by Bhīmasena.
